title: The Pointe Unit 111 - Vacation Rental in The Pointe 30A,FL | 30a Escapes
meta_description: ⚠️ PLEASE NOTE: Wooden beams and framing have been installed on the patios as part of preparations for future community projects. These structures limit direct access to the pool from the patio and partially reduce views from the patios, including the pool area.30A
description_expanded: ⚠️ PLEASE NOTE: Wooden beams and framing have been installed on the patios as part of preparations for future community projects. These structures limit direct access to the pool from the patio and partially reduce views from the patios, including the pool area.30A ESCAPES presents… “The Pointe Unit 111,” a stylish 1st floor condo at The Pointe on 30A. This 2-bedroom retreat features two private patios, upscale interiors, and resort-style amenities—all just a 5-min walk to beach access and town center. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Location: 5-minute walk to Rosemary Beach Town CenterTwo Private Patio: Ground-level outdoor space for morning coffee or evening relaxationSpacious Layout: Open concept with full kitchen and island seatingTwo En-Suite Bedrooms: King and Queen beds with upscale bathroomsResort Amenities: Pool, hot tub, fire pits, grills, and fitness centerOn-Site Dining: 'Big Bad Breakfast' for brunch favoritesBikes Included: 2 adult bikes for guest useEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐“Our family loved our stay at The Pointe. The pool is unbelievable and the beach is close and many restaurants in walking distance.” – Robin B. ⭐“Wonderful location very central to everything. The condo was clean and what we expected. The pool was very nice and not crowded. Would book again.” – Olivia H.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into an inviting open-concept living space that seamlessly connects to the private patio, making it perfect for indoor-outdoor enjoyment. Comfortable furnishings and natural light create a warm and relaxing atmosphere for your 30A getaway.Open-concept living and dining areaSmart TV and plush seatingDirect access to the private patio with resort views*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen featuring sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an oversized island with seating—perfect for preparing meals or gathering with loved ones. Step outside to enjoy al fresco meals at the private patio dining table for 4.Full-size kitchen with modern appliancesQuartz countertops and ample cabinetryIsland seating for 4Private patio with seating for 4—perfect for al fresco dining*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Enjoy two private patios—perfect for morning coffee, evening cocktails, or casual outdoor dining. Whether you’re relaxing in your own space or exploring the community, the outdoor experience is designed for comfort and connection. The resort offers thoughtfully curated amenities to complete your 30A retreat.Two private patios—ideal for lounging or al fresco diningResort-style pool and oversized hot tubGas grills, fire pits, and covered lounge spacesOn-site restaurant ‘Big Bad Breakfast’*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary Suite: King-size bed, Smart TV, and spa-like En-suite with soaking tub, walk-in shower, and double vanityQueen Guest Suite: Queen-size bed, En-suite bathroom with walk-in shower and double sinks*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located near Rosemary and Inlet Beach, this condo places you at the heart of 30A’s most desirable attractions. Spend your days exploring boutique shops and dining at 30Avenue, wandering the charming streets of Rosemary Beach, or adventuring through the natural beauty of Camp Helen State Park, where hiking trails and coastal dune lakes await.5-minute walk to Rosemary Beach Town Center5-minute walk to Winston Lane Public Beach AccessSteps to ‘Big Bad Breakfast’ and other local favorites2-minute bike ride to 30Avenue—shopping, dining, and seasonal events10-minute drive to Camp Helen State Park—hiking, paddling, and natural beauty*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 2 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesWooden beams and framing have been installed on the patios as part of preparations for future community projects. These structures limit direct access to the pool from the patio and partially reduce views from the patios, including the pool area.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 220322
